title: Overlay
description:
A recorded correction to a raw file: a file in `overlays/`. Raw files are
never edited (ARCHITECTURE.md section 6), so a wrong value in one, such as
an antenna type or height in a RINEX header, is corrected here, with who
made the correction, when and why. RINEX ingest (M6) applies overlays in
order of their ids, and the report lists every one.

id.description:
The overlay's id, which is also its file name, such as
`2026-10-15-PM12345A-antenna`.

reason.description: Why: the evidence for the correction, such as the field log.

recorded.description: When it was recorded, in UTC.

rinex.description: Corrections to a RINEX file's header.

schema.description: The schema version: 1 (`SCHEMA`), raised only when a migration is needed.

OverlayId.description: An overlay's id, such as `2026-10-15-PM12345A-antenna`. It's also its file name in `overlays/`.

RinexHeader.description:
Values that replace those in a RINEX header. Only the values given are
replaced.

antenna.description: The antenna's IGS code in ANT # / TYPE.

antenna_delta.description:
ANTENNA: DELTA H/E/N: height, east and north eccentricities of the
antenna reference point from the mark, in metres.

radome.description: The radome's IGS code in ANT # / TYPE.

receiver.description: The receiver type in REC # / TYPE / VERS.

Timestamp.description: A time in UTC, such as 2026-10-14T00:12:00Z.
